name: Microsoft Designer
tagline: Microsoft Designer is a free AI-powered graphic design tool that generates social media posts, invitations, digital postcards, and other visual content from text prompts. Powered by DALL-E for image generation and integrated with Microsoft 365, it suggests complete designs and allows users to customise colours, fonts, and layouts through natural language instructions. It is available as a standalone app and embedded in Microsoft Edge, Teams, and other Microsoft products, bringing AI design capabilities to the 400+ million Microsoft 365 users.
